data.description: Onda by Kasco: Contemporary High-Rise with Breathtaking Views
data.display_address: Onda by Kasco, Business Bay, Dubai
data.long_description:
Introducing Onda by Kasco, a luxurious high-rise in Business Bay that redefines contemporary urban living. Developed exclusively by OCTA Properties and designed by Kasco Real Estate Development LLC, the building’s striking modern exterior exudes sophistication and exclusivity.

The residential complex building is beautifully designed and consists of a high-ceiling first floor, 3 podium levels, 1 floor of prime amenities and 19 residential floors. Studios and 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments are available for purchase. The interiors are decorated in light colors and finished with high quality materials. The spacious layouts of the apartments are carefully designed for maximum comfort. Panoramic glazing provides maximum natural light to the interior spaces.

A remarkable set of amenities is provided for the convenience of the residents. There are an infinity pool on the roof of the building with recreation areas, a relaxation and yoga secluded area, a spa, sauna, cafe, children's and indoor swimming pools, state-of-the-art gym, jogging tracks, and co-working area - everything for maximum comfortable living.

Due to its excellent location in the heart of the metropolis within walking distance of Dubai's iconic attractions it is less than 10 minutes to Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa. City Walk and DIFC in 12 minutes by car, DXB - only in 16 minutes.

For more details or to arrange a private viewing, contact us today!
